name: Donphan
flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

levelUp.name: Fire Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

levelUp.name: Thunder Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

levelUp.name: Horn Attack
levelUp.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Growl
levelUp.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

levelUp.name: Defense Curl
levelUp.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Flail
levelUp.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

levelUp.name: Rapid Spin
levelUp.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

levelUp.name: Rollout
levelUp.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

levelUp.name: Knock Off
levelUp.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

levelUp.name: Take Down
levelUp.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

levelUp.name: Magnitude
levelUp.description: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone in battle. Its power varies.

levelUp.name: Slam
levelUp.description: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Fury Attack
levelUp.description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

levelUp.name: Assurance
levelUp.description: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

levelUp.name: Scary Face
levelUp.description: The user frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Earthquake
levelUp.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

levelUp.name: Superpower
levelUp.description: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

levelUp.name: Giga Impact
levelUp.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Roar
tmHm.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Iron Tail
tmHm.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tmHm.name: Earthquake
tmHm.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Sandstorm
tmHm.description: A five-turn sand- storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

tmHm.name: Rock Tomb
tmHm.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Rock Polish
tmHm.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

tmHm.name: Stone Edge
tmHm.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tmHm.name: Gyro Ball
tmHm.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

tmHm.name: Stealth Rock
tmHm.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Rock Slide
tmHm.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Poison Jab
tmHm.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: Superpower
tutor.description: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Endeavor
tutor.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

tutor.name: AncientPower
tutor.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Earth Power
tutor.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tutor.name: Gunk Shot
tutor.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

tutor.name: Seed Bomb
tutor.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

tutor.name: Iron Defense
tutor.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tutor.name: Bounce
tutor.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

tutor.name: Knock Off
tutor.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.
